question: What is the other name for Riboflavin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin B2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Riboflavin**

 
 
• **​**Riboflavin, also known as **Vitamin B2.**
 
• It is widely found in both plant- and animal-based foods, including** milk, meat, eggs, nuts, enriched flour and green vegetables**.
 
• People commonly use riboflavin to **prevent riboflavin deficiency, migraines, and high levels of homocysteine in the blood.**
 
• Helps the body convert food (carbohydrates) into fuel (glucose), which is used for energy production.
